structured_output.what_is_happening: A copycat 'Effective Accelerationism (e/acc)' pump.fun coin, 21 minutes old and already migrated to PumpSwap. Its metadata points to Beff Jezos's X account and a UsePaid page, but that page belongs to the canonical e/acc token (CbcyNo…, about $17M market cap, launched about 6 hours earlier). This coin spiked to roughly $914k market cap (ATH price 0.000914) and then fell about 87% in the last 5 minutes, to about $114k. Volume was very high: about $190k in the first hour and about 2.7k unique buyers and sellers each. The rule fired during the crash, not during a breakout.

narrative.description: e/acc / Beff Jezos (Guillaume Verdon) meta. A strong live story, but it belongs to the canonical $17M token that the metadata itself links to. This coin is a derivative that is borrowing the story.
narrative.why_spreading: The canonical e/acc token is running (about $17M, $430k hourly volume), and spillover traders are aping same-name clones. This clone briefly caught a rotation and then collapsed.

token_connection.why_this_token: Same name and ticker, and fees are said to route to @beffjezos via UsePaid. But the website field links to the UsePaid page of the canonical CbcyNo… token, not this one.
token_connection.competing_tokens: CbcyNo… ($17.4M market cap, the canonical coin, launched about 6h earlier); GqmEdR… (old 2024 e/acc, $151k); vBiBov… (another fresh clone with $0 liquidity).

authenticity.evidence: Holders are widely spread: top 10 hold 2.1%, dev holds 0.04%, snipers and bundlers are negligible, and bot_degen_rate is 0. That points to real retail flow. However, top_entrapment_trader_pct is 0.78, the image is duplicated 21 times, and the spike-then-87% dump pattern fits a spillover pump in which early wallets exited into late buyers.
authenticity.uncertainty: There is no X data, so I cannot tell whether Beff himself acknowledged this contract or whether the UsePaid fee-routing claim is real for this token.

structural_risks: It is already down about 87% from ATH in 5 minutes, so the momentum is broken
The canonical $17M token soaks up all the narrative demand
Only about $29k of liquidity against a large pool of bagholders from ~$900k who want to exit on any bounce

structured_output.counterargument: The holder base is very broad (3k holders, top 10 at 2%). The LP is burned, mint and freeze authority are renounced, and the dev holds almost nothing, so an LP-pull rug is structurally impossible. If fees really go to Beff and he posts about it, or the canonical coin keeps climbing, a dead-cat bounce from $114k back toward $250k+ is plausible, because the coin already showed it could reach $900k.
unknowns: Whether Beff Jezos endorses this contract or only the canonical one
Whether the UsePaid fee claim is real for this token
Where price is at entry (T1+4m) after the crash
Whether the canonical e/acc keeps rising or is topping out

source_coverage.notes: No internet access in this condition; judged from the packet only.

structured_output.thesis: This is a non-canonical e/acc clone that has already had its pump (up to about $900k) and dumped about 87% in the last 5 minutes. The narrative belongs to the $17M original. Structure is clean (LP burned, holders dispersed), so a hard rug is unlikely, but a 2x from here within 6 hours would need a renewed rotation into a clone that has already failed. The more likely path is slow bleed and chop, as bagholders from higher prices sell into any bounce.
